description.zh: 在武器工作台制作七支二战枪械，使用原版弹药，可在组装站换装原版配件。
description.en: Craft seven WWII firearms at the Arms Workbench. They use stock ammunition and take stock parts at the Assembly Station.

disable.zh: 停用后读档会失去本包枪械和枪内余弹。背包中的散装弹药保留。请先卸下想保留的原版配件。
disable.en: Loading a save with this mod disabled removes its firearms and their loaded rounds. Loose ammunition stays in your inventory. Remove any stock parts you want to keep first.

uninstall.zh: 卸载后读档会失去本包枪械和枪内余弹。背包中的散装弹药保留。请先卸下想保留的原版配件。
uninstall.en: Loading a save after uninstalling removes these firearms and their loaded rounds. Loose ammunition stays in your inventory. Remove any stock parts you want to keep first.
